status: preregistered before H55 fit or holdout; inputs restored from integrity-pinned owner mirrors, not organizer-authenticated
novelty_boundary: Untested execution of an idea already registered as R2-H2. This is not a claim of newness to the repository, geology, or inaccessible sibling projects.
primary_question: Do finite-distance paired elevation shoulders along the local DEM gradient normal improve recovery of whole held-out mapped fault components beyond a fresh, matched View-B baseline, under the same folds and emission budget?

data_inputs.provenance: SHA-256 and byte-count pins in registry/data_manifest.json match owner-supplied sibling-repository mirrors. Organizer authentication is not established.

feature_specification.band_19_role: retained in the View-B baseline features; not used to calculate the local normal
feature_specification.slope_normal: unit gradient of normalized-convolution Gaussian-smoothed band 12; if local gradient magnitude is below 1e-12, direction and H55 channels are zero
feature_specification.sample_method: bilinear interpolation at equal positive/negative offsets along the local gradient normal
channels_per_offset: signed bilateral second difference: z_plus + z_minus - 2*z_center
feature_specification.normalization: No whole-grid or held-out-label normalization. Existing View-B channels and training-fold-only learner settings remain unchanged.
feature_specification.external_data: None for the primary test. The USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM is not substituted.

holdout_protocol.spatial_layout: four contiguous quadrants; whole original 8-connected catalogue components assigned by majority quadrant; evaluation region includes outside-quadrant tails of held components
holdout_protocol.negative_class: catalogue-zero proxy, not verified geological absence
holdout_protocol.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier with parent registration settings; identical train/test rows, sample weights and random seeds for candidate and control
holdout_protocol.primary_control: view_B refit on the identical folds, training rows, learner settings and random seeds
holdout_protocol.placement: same metric-aware placement as the parent registration; same global budget scaled by each evaluation region; visible catalogue pixels excluded
holdout_protocol.primary_metric: mean official DTI over the four whole-component spatially blocked folds

decision_gate.fold_comparison: H55-1 DTI minus fresh matched View-B DTI, fold by fold
decision_gate.failed_or_incomplete_result: research-only; do not spend a weekly submission slot

ranked_hypotheses.title: Paired DEM shoulders (R2-H2)
ranked_hypotheses.layers: Training band 12 (detrended elevation) and band 19 (slope); the transform itself uses band 12.
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Along the local slope normal, compare elevation at equal offsets of 2, 4 and 6 pixels (200, 400 and 600 m) on both sides. Use signed bilateral second difference, balanced shoulder relief and side-to-side asymmetry.
ranked_hypotheses.why_uncatalogued_faults: Small fan scarps or secondary splays may be absent from heterogeneous inventories; paired landforms may persist where absolute curvature is weak.
ranked_hypotheses.alternatives: Roads, gullies, terrace edges and erosion can mimic the signature; a 100 m source grid cannot resolve metre-scale scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Untested execution of a concept already registered as R2-H2; not new-to-repository or globally novel. Existing curvature channels are pointwise/multiscale, not this fixed finite-distance paired-offset arm.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_effect: Moderate possible lift, high uncertainty; no numerical forecast.
ranked_hypotheses.status: primary preregistered; no H55 model/holdout result before the registered test

ranked_hypotheses.title: Conductivity-edge termination and cross-field intersection (R2-H3)
ranked_hypotheses.layers: Training bands 17 (subsurface conductivity surface), 13/18 (gravity products), 2 (RTP magnetics), and 15 (modelled basement depth).
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Locate persistent conductivity-edge endpoints or crossings where a potential-field normal has a different orientation; test the crossing geometry, not conductivity highs alone.
ranked_hypotheses.why_uncatalogued_faults: A covered structural intersection or alteration boundary might accompany a concealed fault missing from a surface map.
ranked_hypotheses.alternatives: Clay, salinity, lithology, survey/model smoothing and correlated gravity-derived layers can produce similar patterns.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Existing code ranks conductivity and gradients; endpoint/crossing geometry is not registered as a model arm. This is not proof of hydrologic alteration.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_effect: Low-to-medium possible lift, high uncertainty; no numerical forecast.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; core layers only. Verify band semantics and units before interpreting amplitudes.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Local competing strain/splay normals (R2-H4)
ranked_hypotheses.layers: Training bands 4, 7 and 8 (strain products), 10/16 (seismicity products), 13/2 (gravity/RTP context), and 12/19 (surface context).
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Quantify local orientation dispersion or competing normal families and short coherent splays; condition local geometry on broad strain/seismic context without sharpening coarse fields into 100 m traces.
ranked_hypotheses.why_uncatalogued_faults: Distributed deformation may use minor splays omitted at map scale even where no dominant mapped range-front trace exists.
ranked_hypotheses.alternatives: Smooth strain/seismic products may locate only a broad region; local edges and acquisition geometry may be confounders.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Prior code uses smooth strain/seismic composites and a single dominant orientation; this tests competing local normal families.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_effect: Low expected 100 m DTI value, high uncertainty; no numerical forecast.
